description: This file contains CKEditor 5 plugin code for HTML embedding, including classes and methods for editing, UI components, and content conversion.

classes.name: c
classes.description: Command class for managing raw HTML embedding, including refresh and execute methods.

classes.name: y
classes.description: UI component class for HTML embed button and menu integration.

classes.name: x
classes.description: Main plugin class integrating the HTML embed functionality into CKEditor 5.

classes.name: u
classes.description: API object for managing raw HTML content editing, including makeEditable, save, and cancel methods.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the command state based on current selection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to insert or update raw HTML content.

methods.name: _setupConversion
methods.description: Sets up content conversion rules between model and view for raw HTML.

methods.name: makeEditable
methods.description: Makes the raw HTML content editable.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the edited raw HTML content.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels editing of raw HTML content.
